title: finding(plugin-dashboard,i18n): the dashboard refresh button reads "Refresh All" / "Refreshing…" (aria-label "Refresh dashboard") in English under zh-CN — now shown on every console dashboard since objectui#11062
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11093 (`Fixes #11062`), from the dev's out-of-scope findings. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## Measured (class a, public door)

In a zh-CN console session (user locale zh-CN, shell rendered in Chinese), the dashboard's refresh button reads 'Refresh All' and, while a refresh runs, 'Refreshing…', both in English.

PR objectui#11093 wires the console dashboard's `onRefresh`. From that merge on, the button shows on every console dashboard, whether or not the dashboard sets a period. Its changeset declares 'Its labels are not localized yet.'

## The sites (read at objectui `origin/main` `873284657`)

- `packages/plugin-dashboard`'s `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` each hard-code 'Refresh All', 'Refreshing…' and the aria-label 'Refresh dashboard'.
- The i18n packs already carry `dashboard.refreshing`. There is no key for "refresh all" or for the aria-label.

## Why it matters

It is the class of objectui#10969, objectui#11039 and objectui#11056: console chrome left English under zh-CN. It is now on every dashboard page.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Keys in all ten packs (reusing `dashboard.refreshing`), read through the package's existing translation path in both components. Pins: a zh render of the button's two states and its aria-label, plus an en control.

Dedupe: the same 1100-item corpus (down to #2231). `Refresh All` has 2 hits: PR objectui#11093, and PR objectui#10995, the hook consolidation, which did not touch the labels. `Refreshing…` has 3 hits: PR objectui#11093, and PR objectui#10831 and PR objectui#10635, which are other surfaces. `Refresh dashboard` has 0.

Dedupe words: Refresh All untranslated dashboard button, DashboardRenderer refresh label i18n, Refreshing hard-coded English, dashboard aria-label Refresh dashboard.
